# Yankee Lady Yacht Charters

Yankee Lady Yacht Charters is a family-owned private event venue on Toronto Harbour, founded in 1984. Yankee Lady is a 113-foot yacht with three decks, capacity for up to 280 cocktail-style guests or 150 seated-dinner guests, a climate-controlled interior, licensed bar and open-air skyline views.

## Verified facts

- Business: Yankee Lady Yacht Charters
- Location: 249 Queens Quay West, Unit 110, Toronto, Ontario M5J 2N5, Canada
- Phone: +1 416 868 0000
- Email: info@yankeelady.ca
- Founded: 1984
- Venue: Yankee Lady, a 113-foot private event yacht
- Service: crewed private yacht charters and event venue hire, not self-drive boat rental
- Capacity: up to 280 cocktail-style guests; up to 150 seated-dinner guests
- Event types: weddings, corporate events, birthdays, anniversaries and private celebrations
- Boarding: Yankee Lady III at 259 Queens Quay West, Toronto, ON; Yankee Lady IV at 539 Queens Quay West, Toronto, ON. Confirm the vessel and meeting point with the team.
- Pricing: a tailored proposal based on date, guest count, event timing and service requirements; no single rental rate is published
- Areas: Humber Bay and Lake Shore pages describe guest origins, not additional docks or guaranteed cruise routes

## Content notes

Submitting an enquiry does not reserve a date or confirm availability. The events team confirms availability, pricing and booking terms personally. Contact the team by phone or email for availability and proposals. FAQ structured data mirrors the visible FAQ text on the corresponding pages.
